S01: Pin exact actor/public keys to a local account/workspace and explicit operation scopes
S02: Admit a nonce once under concurrency and preserve actor-wide replay state across rotation and restart
S03: Recheck key, peer, account and scope revocation atomically during admission
S04: Retain inclusive expiry boundaries, prune strictly expired entries and refuse stale claims
S05: Propagate storage failures and roll back incomplete admission without memory fallback
S06: Integrate the public Foundry verifier with durable callbacks and distinguish retries from receipts
S07: Upgrade populated v5 stores preserving accounts, workspaces and migration checksums
S08: Page peer/key inspection deterministically and report peer versus account suspension separately
S09: Rotate keys atomically, roll back failures and permit only one concurrent replacement
S10: Authorize protected reads only for exact admitted claims with current grants and inclusive expiry
